obfuscation_indicators: encourages readers not to rely on any single measure
risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively precise and heavily quantified, presenting detailed period-over-period drivers for revenue, expenses, capital, and credit quality. The tone is broadly stable and confident, although declining profitability, higher loan-loss provisions, reduced interest-bearing deposits, and market-specific charge-offs indicate moderate emerging risk. Non-GAAP tangible-equity measures and recurring attribution language modestly limit comparability and clarity.
